Follow the section 'Step 5b' of docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md item by item and the design sections 10, 11, 12, 16. Read the tests yourself; map every criterion of REQ-104 (all 13) to a runnable test; look for skip/todo, failure tests without a state check, shared state or order dependence, secrets, absolute machine paths, wide-margin timing assertions that could hide a bug. Run npm test three times in a row and npm run e2e three times (real Chrome, one agent at a time, the Mac crashes under load) and a series of runs of the timing-sensitive tests E2K-33, E2K-43, E2K-45 under load. Check the replacement table row by row against the files and that the number of test( and assert. in the five old files is not lower than at the tag base/E2E104-20261103-01 (designer reports 11/27, 9/54, 38/131, 8/48, 54/275 unchanged). Check the designer's four differences from the design (result.issues I2) and say whether each is acceptable; check issue I4 (raw SAI_CHROME in START_FAILED) stays a recorded Low, not a hidden gap. Kill Chrome only by process id, only your own; temp folders only outside the project. Do not edit the project and do not commit. Report to me in at most 15 lines: PASS or FAIL, criterion coverage, mutants applied/caught and survivors, run results, the replacement table check, findings ranked.

findings.what: No test notices that the runner process lingers after the record line. With the timer left armed, `npm run e2e` takes up to 120 s longer to exit, while duration_ms stays small.
findings.how_to_fix: Add a test that runs the real command path (a child `node` that calls runAll with the stand-in and a quick passing fixture, like INTERRUPT_SCRIPT) and asserts the child exits within a few seconds after printing the record line (no active handle); it must fail for R15.

findings.what: No fixture is a spec that passes every test and still exits non-zero, so the exit-code check in runOne is unpinned.
findings.how_to_fix: Add a fixture (plain file) with one passing test and `process.exitCode = 1` at the end, and a row in E2K-32: code 1, SPEC_FAILED naming exit code 1. Update the counts in E2K-30 (listSpecs) and E2K-34 (9 -> 10 files).

findings.what: The record shape check 'profile folder directly under the temporary root' has no negative row: a record pointing at a deeper folder named sai-e2e-profile-* would be killed and removed.
findings.how_to_fix: Add a record whose profileDir is MY_TMP/<sub>/sai-e2e-profile-xxx (existing, live group) to part (e) and assert nothing is killed or removed.

findings.what: `/sixth|last step/.test(check) || check.includes('npm run e2e')` cannot fail after the loop above it.
findings.how_to_fix: Drop it or assert the word the README really uses.

findings.what: The effect of --no-proxy-server is not shown in a real Chrome (designer difference c); it is pinned only by the exact argument list.
findings.how_to_fix: Accept, or note it in the README; no test change required.
